login.altcha: The browser check did not complete. Wait a few seconds and press the button again.
login.noscript: Signing in needs JavaScript: your browser has to pass a short automatic "I am not a robot" check. Turn JavaScript on and reload the page.
publicadmin.title: Access to the admin interface from the internet
publicadmin.risk.title: This is a potential threat.
publicadmin.risk.text: The admin interface becomes reachable over HTTPS by anyone who knows or guesses the address: it can be found and passwords can be guessed against it. Keeping it off and using the SSH tunnel is safer. If you turn it on, every user needs a strong, unique password, and turn it off again when you do not need it.
publicadmin.off.hint: The admin interface opens only through the SSH tunnel now. To open it at the address above, confirm the risk and enter your password.
publicadmin.on.hint: The admin interface is open at the address above. The SSH tunnel keeps working too.
publicadmin.confirm: I understand the risk: anyone will be able to find the admin interface
publicadmin.password.hint: The password you signed in with, so nobody can do this from a browser you left open.
publicadmin.enabled: The admin interface is open to the internet: {url}. The first visit there may take up to a minute while the certificate is issued.
publicadmin.disabled: Access from the internet is closed. The admin interface opens only through the SSH tunnel.
publicadmin.need_confirm: Tick "I understand the risk" and enter your password.
publicadmin.bad_password: Wrong password. Enter the password you signed in with.
publicadmin.note: The admin interface is also open to the internet, without the SSH tunnel:
audit.action.settings.public_admin: Access to the admin interface from the internet changed
